title: Project Constraint
description: A project-level or scoped restriction that applicable implementations must not violate.

schema_version.description: The version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this constraint document.

id.description: A stable, unique identifier assigned and verified by the Extension. The identifier must not be changed when the document content is revised.

title.description: A concise human-readable title describing the restriction.

description.description: A detailed explanation of the restriction, its purpose, and the circumstances in which it matters.

level.description: The applicability level of the constraint. Project applies across the repository; directory and module indicate narrower scopes.

items.description: A repository-relative path identifying a constrained directory or module.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths identifying the constrained directories or modules. An empty array means that no narrower path restriction is specified.

scope.description: The part of the project to which the constraint applies. The Extension must additionally verify that path values are valid repository-relative paths.

rule.description: The normative restriction that applicable changes and implementations must satisfy.

severity.description: The severity assigned to a violation. Error indicates a blocking violation under the configured enforcement policy; warning indicates a non-blocking violation that must be reported.

method.description: The primary method used to determine whether the constraint is satisfied.

validator.description: The identifier of a configured automated validator or checking mechanism. Null is permitted when verification does not use a named automated validator.

instructions.description: Instructions explaining how to verify compliance, including manual review criteria when automated validation is unavailable.

verification.description: The verification strategy for the constraint. The Extension must verify that any non-null validator refers to an available or configured checking mechanism when automated execution is required.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the constraint. The Extension controls effective state transitions and must not trust an Agent-supplied approved value.
